items.title: Live: Nifty sees U-turn after cautious start, above 25,400; Auto stocks rev up | Closing Bell
items.description: Join us for Closing Bell on Moneycontrol as we wrap up the trading session on Thursday, November 19. The Nifty saw a U-turn after a cautious start and moved above 25,400, with a cooling-off in commodities lifting the market mood. Brent crude eased towards $93 a barrel, while gold and metals stayed under pressure after the sharp sell-off seen earlier in the day. Auto stocks revved up through the session and led the action among sectors. We break down the key sectors and stock-specific moves that shaped the day, the market breadth and how the broader indices fared, and the global cues from the Fed minutes, US bond yields and Asian markets. We also look at the FII and DII activity, what the Anthropic listing and the Trump-Xi-Putin meeting mean for sentiment, and what traders should watch for in the next session.

items.title: Live: Nifty may extend loss amid tepid global cues; Brent at $93 | Opening Bell
items.description: Join us for Opening Bell on Moneycontrol as we get you ready for the trading session on Thursday, November 19. Wall Street ended mixed as investors digested Nvidia’s quarterly results and weighed the hawkish tone of the Fed minutes, which show that almost all officials expect more rate hikes. Asian markets are trading lower, while GIFT Nifty points to a subdued start for Indian equities. Yesterday the Nifty snapped its two-day winning streak to settle at 25,227 and the Bank Nifty ended at 62,038, with broader markets under pressure. We break down the FII and DII activity from the previous session, US bond yields, the stronger dollar, crude near $93 a barrel, and the sell-off in gold and metals, and what it all means for Dalal Street today. We also look at Anthropic’s record-breaking IPO and market debut, the Trump-Xi-Putin meeting in Shenzhen ahead of the APEC summit, and the latest on the India-US trade deal talks.
